rows.description: Snoopy runs a Beagle Scout troop at Camp Spring Lake, where every badge, campfire, and ring-toss tournament becomes a full Peanuts production. Parents can expect camp stories about measuring up, camp crushes, and scary firsts, each one settled by a friend's patient reframe.
rows.age_band_basis: All 52 tagged rows age 5-7 (Camp Snoopy Script Dev Set, wb_Awh3JEB3).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Camp Snoopy script dev set (52 script-tier segment rows; representative episodes reviewed this session). Age band unanimous (52/52).
rows.what_happens: Snoopy runs a Beagle Scout troop at Camp Spring Lake. Every badge, campfire, and ring-toss tournament tends to swell into a full Peanuts production.
rows.feelings: The troop feels nerves, embarrassment, and frustration. Pride waits at the end of the hard thing.
rows.situation: Camp-season firsts: measuring up against friends, scary first tries, crushes, and being the new one at the lake.
rows.resolution: A friend's patient reframe turns panic into a plan, and the troop takes the scary first on together.
rows.series_overview: Snoopy runs his Beagle Scout troop in full beagle style, turning every badge, campfire, and tournament at Spring Lake into a Peanuts-scale production.

rows.description: Doug is a boy robot making deliveries in the big city, and every errand turns into a hands-on lesson in how humans play, celebrate, and explore. Parents can expect easygoing stories where a failed plan is treated as information for the next try.
rows.age_band_basis: All 14 tagged rows age 2-4 (Batch 1 Series Script Dev Set, wb_CugBbpqS).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Batch 1 Series dev set (14 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Early-season coverage, so the description stays close to those episodes. Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Doug is a boy robot who makes deliveries in the big city with his human friend Emma. Every errand becomes a hands-on lesson in how humans play, celebrate, and explore.
rows.feelings: Confusion and disappointment come first when the human world refuses to work like a manual. Pride comes when it clicks.
rows.situation: New experiences that flop on the first try: a rained-out trip, a lost game, a job nobody will explain.
rows.resolution: A failed plan is information. Rework it with a friend and try the next way.
rows.series_overview: A boy robot named Doug delivers far and wide, discovering how humans celebrate, wonder, and try the next way when something flops.

rows.description: Duck and Goose, two small birds with big opinions, guard a found egg, build a kite from spare parts, and turn every meadow errand into an expedition. Parents can expect gentle stories about patience, sharing, and giving a friend's way of doing things an honest try.
rows.age_band_basis: All 33 tagged rows age 2-4 (Batch 1 Series Script Dev Set, wb_CugBbpqS).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Batch 1 Series dev set (33 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Duck and Goose are two small birds with big opinions. They guard a found egg, build a kite from spare parts, and turn every meadow errand into an expedition.
rows.feelings: First the frustration and worry. Then pride and joy, once they get there.
rows.situation: Two very different friends learning to share, take turns, and give the other one's way an honest try.
rows.resolution: A setback becomes a clue. Patience, teamwork, or a borrowed idea gets them there together.
rows.series_overview: Two very different friends learning to share, take turns, and give the other one's way an honest try.

rows.description: Eva Wingdale, an enthusiastic young owl in Treetopington, throws herself into contests, weddings, and class projects with plans that are bigger than her wingspan. Parents can expect school-and-family stories where good intentions wobble and get a kind correction.
rows.age_band_basis: All 16 tagged rows age 2-4 (Batch 1 Series Script Dev Set, wb_CugBbpqS).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Batch 1 Series dev set (16 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Coverage is thin relative to the full run. Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Eva Wingdale is an enthusiastic young owl in Treetopington who throws herself into contests, weddings, and class projects. Her plans are always bigger than her wingspan.
rows.feelings: Disappointment and impatience come first. Pride lands once the wobble is worked out.
rows.situation: Big plans and good intentions that wobble: a contest entry that fails, a helping hand that was not asked for, a job taken on too soon.
rows.resolution: Eva names what went wrong. A kind correction from a parent or teacher turns the miss into something she can use next time.
rows.series_overview: Eva Wingdale, an eager young owl in Treetopington, throws herself into contests and class projects with plans bigger than her wingspan.

rows.description: Frog and Toad live a quiet, loyal friendship one small domestic story at a time: cookies, letters, gardens, and lost buttons. Parents can expect gentle, funny episodes about willpower, worry, waiting, and the small gestures that make a friend feel known.
rows.age_band_basis: All 16 tagged rows age 2-4 (Batch 1 Series Script Dev Set, wb_CugBbpqS).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Batch 1 Series dev set (16 script-tier rows, Season 1; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Frog and Toad live a quiet, loyal friendship one small domestic story at a time: cookies, letters, gardens, and lost buttons.
rows.feelings: The show holds worry, frustration, and loneliness gently, never far from a laugh.
rows.situation: The small daily struggles: willpower, waiting, worry at bedtime, wanting to feel brave.
rows.resolution: A small gesture does the settling: a letter that says what a best friend should, a jacket with the buttons sewn extra tight.
rows.series_overview: Cookies, letters, gardens, and lost buttons: a frog and a toad savor them in funny, tender tales of quiet loyalty.

rows.description: Otis, a friendly little tractor on a busy farm, helps his neighbors through rescues, contests, and hard days with steady, puttering determination. Parents can expect farm stories where calm problem-solving and looking out for a friend carry the day.
rows.age_band_basis: All 34 tagged rows age 2-4 (Wave 3 Batch 1 Script Dev Set, wb_DIQCgz1L).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 1 dev set (34 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous. Popup blocks: series-level resolution mode drawn from the 34 script-tier rows; the single synopsis-only row did not change it.
rows.what_happens: Otis is a friendly little tractor on a busy farm. He helps his neighbors through rescues, contests, and hard days with steady, puttering determination.
rows.feelings: Worry and nervousness about trying hard things get soothed into calm and courage.
rows.situation: Being scared to try, getting lost or left out, and the wish to be a helper like the big machines.
rows.resolution: A deep breath, a steady friend, and one step at a time: asking for help is part of being a helper.
rows.series_overview: Otis the tractor putters to every rescue and hard day on his farm with steady, dependable heart.

rows.description: Kids at a Brooklyn bookstore crack mysteries by letter when a ghost rearranges words, and storybook characters step off their pages and into the case. Parents can expect team-sleuth stories about research, disagreement, and telling the truth even when it costs something.
rows.age_band_basis: All 39 tagged rows age 8-10 (Wave 3 Batch 2 Script Dev Set, wb_mHUXZU8R).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 2 dev set (39 script-tier rows across seasons; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Kids at a Brooklyn bookstore crack mysteries by letter when a ghost rearranges words. Storybook characters even step off their pages and into the case.
rows.feelings: Mysteries bring worry and confusion, but the bravery comes from being scared together.
rows.situation: Disagreement on a team, change pressing on a family, and the cost of telling the truth when a lie would be easier.
rows.resolution: The team works it by method: write down what you know, follow the evidence, and let the truth, not the comfortable story, win.
rows.series_overview: When a ghost scrambles words inside a Brooklyn bookstore, four kid sleuths chase the answers as figures from beloved classics wander off their pages.

rows.description: Harriet M. Welsch, a sixth grader with a notebook and a spy route, writes down exactly what the grown-ups and classmates around her would rather keep private. Parents can expect stories about observation, friendship honesty, and a young detective learning to face her own flaws.
rows.age_band_basis: 20 tagged rows (Wave 3 Batch 2, wb_mHUXZU8R): 12 at 8-10, 8 at 5-7; majority band 8-10.
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 2 dev set (20 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Age bands conflict (8-10 vs 5-7); picked the majority and flagged here per the task rule.
rows.what_happens: Harriet M. Welsch is a sixth grader with a notebook and a spy route. She writes down exactly what the grown-ups and classmates around her would rather keep private.
rows.feelings: Embarrassment, loneliness, and jealousy run through every chapter, and being seen stings.
rows.situation: Honesty that hurts: a notebook that wounds a friend, a fight that leaves you out, envy of someone else's easy life.
rows.resolution: Harriet learns to point her honesty at herself first. She names her own faults and apologizes her way back into her friendships.
rows.series_overview: With her notebook and her spy route, sixth grader Harriet M. Welsch writes down exactly what her classmates and the grown-ups around her would rather keep private.

rows.description: Cody, a monster who loves to plan, walks preschoolers through one everyday problem per short episode with songs, play, and the Helpster habit of asking for another way. Parents can expect bite-size modeling of naming a plan, adapting when it changes, and thanking the helpers.
rows.age_band_basis: All 6 tagged rows age 2-4 (Wave 3 Batch 2 Script Dev Set, wb_mHUXZU8R).
rows.notes: Grounded in 6 script-tier rows for the Helpsters Help You shorts. The main Helpsters S1-S3 tagging (Batches 20-21) is outside the finder corpus. Coverage is thin; the description stays to what the shorts show. Age band unanimous. Popup blocks stay within the six tagged Helpsters Help You shorts.
rows.what_happens: Cody is a monster who loves to plan. Each short episode walks preschoolers through one everyday problem with songs, play, and the Helpster habit of asking for another way.
rows.feelings: Disappointment shows up when plans change. Being helped and helping both feel good.
rows.situation: The situations are small: a plan that falls through, a closed park, a friend who is far away.
rows.resolution: Name the plan, change it when it changes, break it into small steps, and thank the helpers.
rows.series_overview: Cody the monster who loves to map things out sings, builds, and sorts out one everyday problem per short episode, always ready to ask for another way.

rows.description: Piper, the little red chicken, keeps bursting into Papa's bedtime stories to fix the characters' problems, and every interruption rewrites the tale. Parents can expect bedtime-framed stories where big feelings meet fairy-tale chaos and Papa models calm, creative redirecting.
rows.age_band_basis: All 33 tagged rows age 5-7 (Wave 3 Batch 1 Script Dev Set, wb_DIQCgz1L).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 1 dev set (33 script-tier rows, S1 plus S0; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Piper is the little red chicken who keeps bursting into Papa's bedtime stories to fix the characters' problems. Every interruption rewrites the tale.
rows.feelings: Confusion and frustration set in when the story will not cooperate. Pride returns when a new idea saves it.
rows.situation: This speaks to big bedtime feelings and the urge to jump in and fix everything before it is your turn to listen.
rows.resolution: Papa's calm redirect hands her a tool instead of a scolding: one story beat, one simile, one why, and the tale works again.
rows.series_overview: Piper the little red chicken keeps bursting into Papa's bedtime books, and every interruption sends the story somewhere brand new.

rows.description: Pretzel and Poppy's seven dachshund puppies take on their city one small project at a time, from a community mural to the Kibble Cart Derby. Parents can expect upbeat stories about inclusion and problem-solving, including redesigning rules that leave someone out.
rows.age_band_basis: All 34 tagged rows age 2-4 (Wave 3 Batch 1 Script Dev Set, wb_DIQCgz1L).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 1 dev set (34 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Pretzel and Poppy's seven dachshund puppies take on their city one small project at a time, from a community mural to the Kibble Cart Derby.
rows.feelings: A rule or a wall brings sadness and frustration. Pulling it off together brings pride.
rows.situation: Being left out by a rule that fits someone else: a derby only for long dogs, a treat a friend cannot eat, a sibling who needs a turn.
rows.resolution: The pups redesign the rule so nobody sits it out. The fix usually ends up helping more than the pack.
rows.series_overview: Seven dachshund puppies roll across their big city from a community mural to the Kibble Cart Derby, making room for everyone along the way.

rows.description: Harvey and his Sagoville friends turn everyday errands and rituals into play, from waiting for pizza to a gnome wedding held every Wednesday. Parents can expect gentle preschool comedy about waiting, small letdowns, and finding something to be thankful for.
rows.age_band_basis: All 45 tagged rows age 2-4 (Wave 3 Batch 1 Script Dev Set, wb_DIQCgz1L).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 1 dev set (45 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Harvey and his Sagoville friends turn everyday errands and rituals into play, from waiting for pizza to a gnome wedding held every Wednesday.
rows.feelings: Impatience and worry build in the waiting. Sharing the worry settles it warm.
rows.situation: Waiting for something you want now, small letdowns, and a friend whose day went wrong.
rows.resolution: Say the hard feeling out loud, then turn the wait or the letdown into a game everyone can play.
rows.series_overview: In Sagoville, Harvey and his pals turn ordinary errands into games, from waiting for pizza to a gnome wedding held every Wednesday.

rows.description: Square, Circle, and Triangle share a small island and a long history of pranks, projects, and feelings named out loud. Parents can expect wry, slow-paced stories about friendship frictions and disappointment that end in quiet understanding.
rows.age_band_basis: 34 tagged rows (Wave 3 Batch 1, wb_DIQCgz1L): 19 at 2-4, 15 at 5-7; majority band 2-4.
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 1 dev set (34 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Age bands conflict (19 vs 15); picked the majority and flagged. The wry register may skew older than 2-4 for some parents; worth a re-read if rows accumulate. Popup blocks follow the same 34-row dev set; the wry-register caveat above applies to the Feelings and Situation blocks too.
rows.what_happens: Square, Circle, and Triangle share a small island and a long history of pranks, projects, and feelings named out loud.
rows.feelings: Jealousy, embarrassment, guilt, and impatience all get their moments, in more shades than most shows for this age allow.
rows.situation: Friendship friction that builds quietly: a prank that goes too far, a friend's good news that stings, a gift given for the wrong reason.
rows.resolution: The feeling gets said out loud, and the story ends in quiet understanding rather than a big fix.
rows.series_overview: Square, Circle, and Triangle prank, build, and name their feelings out loud on an island where prickly moments settle into understanding.

rows.description: Stillwater, a wise and playful panda, helps siblings Karl, Michael, and Addy with one real-life difficulty per story, paired with a folk tale that reframes it. Parents can expect calm episodes about disappointment, patience, and big feelings settling down.
rows.age_band_basis: 77 tagged rows (Stillwater Secret Sauce Dev Set, wb_McM7y4Xx): 67 at 5-7, 10 at 2-4; majority band 5-7.
rows.notes: Grounded in the Stillwater dev set (77 rows, script tier including Allie's 20 hand tags; representative episodes reviewed). Age bands conflict (67 vs 10); picked the majority and flagged.
rows.what_happens: Stillwater is a wise, playful panda who helps siblings Karl, Michael, and Addy with one real-life difficulty per story. Each story is paired with a folk tale that reframes it.
rows.feelings: Frustration, disappointment, and loneliness stack up in an ordinary week.
rows.situation: Fairness and disappointment in a child's day: a race lost, a sibling who gets there first, a turn that never seems to come.
rows.resolution: Stillwater's calm questions and a folk-tale parallel let the feeling settle. Talking it out or saying sorry does the rest.
rows.series_overview: Karl, Michael, and Addy bring their childhood stumbles to a wise, playful panda, each one paired with a folk tale that reframes it.

rows.description: Sam and Jade spend their California summer chasing the mystery of Danger Point, where surf sessions share the beach with ghost stories and buried doubloons. Parents can expect adventure-mystery episodes where friendship and a science-minded check on every theory do the work.
rows.age_band_basis: All 10 tagged rows age 8-10 (Wave 3 Batch 2 Script Dev Set, wb_mHUXZU8R).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 2 dev set (10 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Limited episode coverage. Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Sam and Jade spend their California summer chasing the mystery of Danger Point, where surf sessions share the beach with ghost stories and buried doubloons.
rows.feelings: Worry and confusion deepen as the mystery does. Guilt and disappointment creep in when friendship slips.
rows.situation: A friendship stretched by different priorities, a parent told the truth the hard way, and secrets that will not stay small.
rows.resolution: Hypothesis, evidence, and honest talk: form the theory, check it, and say the true thing to your friend even when it stings.
rows.series_overview: Sam and Jade split their California summer between surf sessions and the ghostly mystery of Danger Point, where buried doubloons wait with the clues.

rows.description: Orphaned sisters Sabrina and Daphne arrive in Ferryport Landing with a grandmother who claims fairy-tale characters are real, and a town full of evidence. Parents can expect detective-style fantasy adventure, a shadowy villain, and a family that closes ranks under pressure.
rows.age_band_basis: All 6 tagged rows age 8-10 (Wave 3 Batch 2 Script Dev Set, wb_mHUXZU8R).
rows.notes: Grounded in 6 script-tier rows covering the opening arc only. Coverage is thin; the description stays close to the tagged arc. Age band unanimous. Popup blocks stay within the six tagged opening-arc rows.
rows.what_happens: Orphaned sisters Sabrina and Daphne arrive in Ferryport Landing with a grandmother who claims fairy-tale characters are real, and a town full of evidence.
rows.feelings: Fear and loneliness follow them into a town that may not want them. The courage is the kind sisters talk each other into.
rows.situation: Family upheaval: parents missing, a stranger who says she is family, and sisters who have to parent each other.
rows.resolution: The family closes ranks: detective work, sticking together, and letting new allies earn their trust one honest conversation at a time.
rows.series_overview: Orphaned sisters Sabrina and Daphne land in a town where make-believe is real, the villain is shadowy, and family closes ranks under pressure.

rows.description: Wolfboy, the masked kid who never fit in, follows two strange creatures down a portal to the Spryte world and an underground factory where weird ideas are the whole job. Parents can expect imaginative adventures about belonging, friendship repair, and mistakes that become something better.
rows.age_band_basis: All 36 tagged rows age 5-7 (Wave 3 Batch 1 Script Dev Set, wb_DIQCgz1L).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 1 dev set (36 script-tier rows; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Wolfboy is the masked kid who never fit in. He follows two strange creatures down a portal to the Spryte world and an underground factory where weird ideas are the job.
rows.feelings: He worries about being the odd one out and feels embarrassment when he blunders. The brave shows up anyway.
rows.situation: Being the new kid or the weird kid: bracing for rejection, blundering in front of your peers, wanting a place that fits.
rows.resolution: The blunder becomes the build. Mistakes turn into inventions, and the quirk that got him mocked is the thing the factory was made for.
rows.series_overview: Wolfboy trades feeling like a misfit for a job at the Everything Factory, where weird ideas are celebrated and oddballs fit right in.

rows.description: Eva Nine leaves the underground sanctuary where a robot raised her and steps onto an alien surface where walking trees and flying whales break every rule in her training. Parents can expect serialized science-fiction adventure with pursuit and peril, a found family, and the question of where a person belongs.
rows.age_band_basis: All 20 tagged rows age 8-10 (Wave 3 Batch 2 Script Dev Set, wb_mHUXZU8R).
rows.notes: Grounded in the Wave 3 Batch 2 dev set (20 script-tier rows, S1 chapters; representative episodes reviewed). Age band unanimous.
rows.what_happens: Eva Nine leaves the underground sanctuary where a robot raised her. On the alien surface, walking trees and flying whales break every rule in her training.
rows.feelings: Fear and loneliness follow her far from everything familiar. Boldness grows from needing to find out.
rows.situation: Leaving the only home you know and learning, step by step, who your people are.
rows.resolution: Found family carries her: accept the help offered, trust your own senses, and let the ones who walk with you become home.
rows.series_overview: Raised underground by a devoted machine, Eva Nine steps onto an alien surface of walking trees and flying whales, chased by peril and finding the ones who become her own.
